title: The 3-hour rule that kills most new projects
caption: The 3-hour rule that kills most new projects. Your idea is not dying from a lack of tutorials.

scenes.voice: The 3 hour rule that kills most new projects.

scenes.text:
Most people
"work on it"
for 11 minutes.
scenes.voice: Most people work on it for 11 minutes.

scenes.text:
No new tools.
No new tabs.

scenes.text:
That is how
ugly versions
get finished.

You are not
short on ideas.

on a clock.

Close the rest.
